title: Extension of Application Deadline for Group-A and Group-B Posts on Deputation
summary: The Department of Space (DOS) has extended the application deadline for Group-A and Group-B posts in the DOS Secretariat, Bengaluru, on a deputation basis. The new last date for receipt of applications is November 30, 2026. All other terms and conditions of the original Office Memorandum dated October 09, 2026, remain unchanged.
eligibility_bullets: Candidates must be eligible officers for deputation.
how_to_apply_steps: Eligible Officers must forward their applications to Director (Personnel & Administration), Department of Space, Antariksh Bhavan, New BEL Road, Bangalore- 560 094, on or before the deadline.
